ruled.desc: A reviewer sandbox could not run the tests: a limit of the review environment, not a defect of the build.

defects.desc: The new test calls stat -f %HT, which is BSD syntax; GNU stat fails on Linux, so the test throws before the agent runs.

The idle-runner filter compares an offer's projects with the project's current name only, so a runner that polled under a former name before a rename is dropped from the idle list although its token still serves the project.
